text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"(—No abnormalities in the classrooms on
this floor. Likely thanks to the awareness
raised by our Morals Committee.
However, there are those who set traps
that cannot be cracked down upon by school
rules alone...)"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...I sense it. The scent of danger.
Dad always said, as a police officer, that
an incident carries a distinct
atmosphere.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Hm!? ...I smell something.
It smells like a crime scene... Danger
might be lurking—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Waugh! Wh-what the!? ...A, a net?
She took the bait, now's our chance!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Wondered who stepped into my trap,
and it turns out to be you, Meno.
Did that patrol of yours backfire on ya?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"A trap...! So that's what that scent was
back then...
Nakayama-san, bringing me to a place like
this... is obstruction of school duties!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
――No, think of it as assisting with future
academy duties. It's a dry run, just humor
me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Tracen Academy!!
Congrats on getting in, you fresh little
freshmen on the chopping block~~☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, Golshi-chan Senpai is
gonna teach everyone the Tracen Academy
way,
hand-in-hand, step-by-step, and
flea-by-flea!☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Academy is a ruthless battlefield!
A graveyard for gamblers!
Only those with proper resolve may pass
through these gates! Got that, you fry?!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Wha—!? Are you planning to teach lies to
incoming students?!
And through such brute-force methods...! A
crime! This is practically a crime!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
D-O-N-'-T M-O-V-E! S-E-C-U-R-I-N-G T-H-E
T-A-R-G-E-T!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, the freshmen are gonna need it! In
this academy,
people'll challenge you to a race around
every corner!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though most of this would be
solved
if you all simply did not challenge them
to a match!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all. Starting with the
scramble for yakisoba pan,
to the traditional inter-dorm cleaning
duty showdowns...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And where there's a mysterious Academy
event, a showdown is bound to follow.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, races are showdowns too.
Settling things fair and square through
competition in the end—that's the Tracen
Academy way, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. You're having quite the interesting
discussion.
Are these measures prepared for the
arrival of the new students?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I believe Nakayama-san and the others
have a point as well.
A match yields clear results. It should
prevent any further disputes."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"......I feel that is no different from
subduing them by force, however.
Frightening the new students is hardly the
right approach—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, we cannot eliminate all forms of
competition. This academy has many
hot-blooded Umamusume... so isn't learning
to adapt necessary as well?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The newcomers among the populace are
unrefined. There may even be lawless
elements mingled among them.
See to it that they are properly made to
understand their place."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Meno, your aura is way scarier!
If you walk up to a freshman, they'll
probably wet their pants!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"......It is plausible. In front of new
students, I might tense up, causing my
expression to harden.
My intensity would increase. A total mass
of intimidation."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, Meno! Let's do some special training!
We'll act as the freshmen for ya!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—You! You must be a new student. What are
you doing here?
What is your destination? I shall guide
you, so move immediately!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, scary! The pressure is insane!
It's so terrifying it's hilarious. Gotta
snap a pic for the memories.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Cease this at once, sir!
Taking photos without the subject's
consent is a violation of portrait rights—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Waaay. Come on, Senpai, smile too~
Let's do burst mode. Way-way-way-waaay☆

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!! Put down your hands first...
UN! AU! THO! RIZED! PHO! TO! GRA! PHY! IS!
FOR! BID! DEN! ...sir!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Then, I shall go next.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your daily patrols, Senpai.
We truly appreciate your care and
dedication to us new students.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"! To create an academy where everyone can
live in peace!
That is the purpose of this patrol. If
anything happens, do not hesitate to speak
up!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"May I really rely on you?
Though consulting you over trivial matters
would only be a bother..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No. No matter how trivial it may seem, it
doesn't matter, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"(...Then again, my opponent is
Journey-senpai.
Her true motives are inscrutable... I'll
have to stay on guard for an ulterior
motive)"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"How reassuring. Truth be told, I do
occasionally worry about security here.
Will you be able to handle situations like
that as well?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Depending on the circumstances, yes.
...Is there someone in particular you wish
for me to crack down on, sir?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! That's not what I meant...!
I apologize, this is far too personal of
an issue. I will manage it myself."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot approve of this.
If you deal with it yourself—it would be
troublesome if people took that as me
condoning a private duel."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Enough of this farce.
Our throat is parched, dear Sister."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"What, already over?
And here I was planning to play with you a
bit."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"A tedious sideshow.
Meno, apply yourself diligently."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is not a side show! ...Wait a moment?
Come to think of it,
weren't you also feared by the freshmen
every year, Orfe-san?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A king is meant to be feared.
It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"............ The new students are going
to be thrown right into the middle of this
toxic mess...?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—In that case! It is my immediate duty to
strictly discipline these troublemakers!
I, Fenomeno, shall protect the safe
livelihood of our new students!
